title: Add Two Numbers
statement: Two non-negative integers are stored as linked lists with their digits in REVERSE order, one digit per node. Add them and return the sum in the same reversed form.
constraints: no leading zeros except the number 0
hints: Reverse order is a gift: you meet the least significant digits first, which is where addition starts.
Walk both lists together holding a carry, and keep going while either list has nodes left OR the carry is non-zero.
Treat a missing node as digit 0. A dummy head node keeps the append loop uniform.
